scope: Phase Two evaluation engine and frozen synthetic regression gate
state_note: Review of uncommitted implementation. Root began fixes after receiving findings; this is the initial review, not a claim about the later fixed state.
method: Read-only code, contract and public metadata review, plus hand-calculated synthetic probes. No patient transcript, private annotation, original source file or OCR cache was read.

findings.title: Prediction-driven assignment hides swapped indicator mappings
findings.evidence: Two distinct names on one page, both value 5.2 and unit g/L, were correctly transcribed but assigned each other's LAB_A/LAB_B codes. The current Hungarian weights prefer matching predicted code (60) over source name (50), yielding assignment {1:0,0:1}, joint F1=1, code recall=1 and severe.errors=0. Raw-name recall was 0.
findings.expected: Preserve source-row identity and count both wrong mappings. Whole-report association must not be repaired by optimizing the candidate's scored fields.
findings.recommendation: Match using independent source evidence and source names before candidate code/value; add equal-value swapped-code controls and carry one fixed assignment into breakdowns.

findings.title: Tier slicing discards false positives on pages without truth in that tier
findings.evidence: A correct TIER_1 LAB_A plus a spurious TIER_2 LAB_B on the same annotated lab page produced whole FP=1 and precision=0.5, but TIER_1 FP=0 and TIER_2 FP=0/unassessed; unassigned_prediction_rows was 0.
findings.expected: The false positive remains assessed in its fixed tier even when no true item of that tier occurs on the page.
findings.recommendation: Derive tier counts from a single global assignment and retain the original complete assessment scope instead of rebuilding annotated pages from tier-filtered truth.

findings.title: Blanket downgrading reliable controls passes the synthetic gate
findings.evidence: A synthetic monkeypatch preserved values and source evidence but changed all 554 outputs to SEARCH_ONLY and added recognition_uncertain, downgrading 372 formerly STABLE rows. The fixed regression still returned passed=true, zero failures, severe blocked=9/9.
findings.expected: Reliable normal controls must not be incorrectly routed by the same checks that intercept known errors; normal false-routing numerator and denominator must be visible.
findings.recommendation: Assert explicit must_block=false cases and independently frozen normal capability/quality expectations. Report normal routing counts and fail when those controls regress.

findings.title: Partial truth is treated as a complete page and unknown severe fields become zero error
findings.evidence: With report g1 explicitly target_rows_complete=false, one annotated row A and another unannotated output B on that page produced FP=1 and one unintercepted severe error. The report-completeness flags are ignored. Separately, a name-matched row with all four severe fields unknown produced assessed_predictions=1 and severe.error_rate=0.0 despite no severe field being assessable.
findings.expected: Unknown/unassessed scope must remain distinguishable from verified false positives or zero severe-error rates.
findings.recommendation: Only score unmatched rows as false positives inside a declared complete scope; retain unmatched partial-scope rows and unknown severe-field rows in explicit unassessed counters. Return null severe error rate when no applicable field is assessable.
findings.real_data_impact: Not established: private classification/transcripts were intentionally not inspected. The failures are reproducible evaluator-contract defects.

findings.title: Real evaluation identity omits executed normalization dependencies and runtime
findings.evidence: Real parser_files omits tools/sample_dictionary/normalize.py and apps/processing/value_objects.py despite extraction/candidates importing their behavior. It also records no Python, Unicode or Django runtime versions and no coverage artifact hash. The synthetic gate already hashes the normalization/value-object files and Python/Unicode versions.
findings.expected: An input that can change parsing, evaluation or tier membership must change the reproducibility identity.
findings.recommendation: Include the complete executed evaluation dependency set and runtime identity, plus the frozen tier/target coverage bytes, in the real evaluation identity.

additional_observations.evidence: A correct target plus an unmatched duplicate of the same target with a wrong value still produced dual_column complete_target_association_groups=1 and rate=1.0.
additional_observations.recommendation: When resolving P2-EVAL-01/02, make the whole-report criterion explicit about unexpected incorrect target associations and carry their failures into the report-level outcome.

positive_evidence: All 125 fixed target positives and negatives are executed separately from 50 genes; missing targets retain the fixed denominator.
Parser exceptions and absent observations fail closed in the synthetic gate.
Only the exact frozen legacy byte hash and definition hash may claim the limited legacy scope.
Frozen-source replay validates original bytes, OCR-cache bytes, page counts and source/page sequence; baseline predictions are checked against per-source frozen hashes.
Adjudication metadata records two source-only field passes, resolved disagreements and explicit independence limitations.
Real and synthetic metrics are explicitly separated and development samples are not claimed as holdout/generalization evidence.

verification.command: Synthetic snippets reproduced in the private .runtime/phase-two-evaluation-review-probes.py script
verification.result: Initial observed outcomes recorded per finding; rerun after fixes required

not_reviewed: Publication call integration being changed concurrently by root
Custom dictionary/rule CLI support beyond the explicitly disclosed bundled no-enabled-rules run
Private medical transcripts, original source files and private OCR caches
Product UI and broad application behavior
Known preliminary real-artifact code-hash staleness; root has already scheduled a final rerun
remaining: Fix the confirmed findings, then rerun focused tests, independent synthetic probes and the real frozen-source evaluation on the final runtime/code identity.
